Package com.hkust.marketplace.services

Record Class DealDetails

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.hkust.marketplace.services.DealDetails
Record Components:
residenceHall - the buyer's residence hall, or null if none or the account was deleted
sellerBio - the seller's bio, or null
amount - the offered price for a sale, otherwise null
borrowStart - the borrow period start for a loan, otherwise null
borrowEnd - the borrow period end for a loan, otherwise null
reviewed - true if the buyer reviewed this deal
reviewHidden - true if that review was hidden by the admin
public record DealDetails(Offer offer, Listing listing, String buyerUsername, String buyerFullName, String residenceHall, String sellerUsername, String sellerFullName, String sellerBio, ListingType dealType, Double amount, LocalDateTime borrowStart, LocalDateTime borrowEnd, LocalDateTime startDate, LocalDateTime completedDate, DealState state, boolean reviewed, boolean reviewHidden) extends Record
Everything the admin sees for VIEW DETAILS on one deal (Task 3.5, step 4.1). It holds no password hashes. Admin-only.
